fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 3,500 was withdrawn. The matter was brought to Chennai North PS on 2025-08-26, while the incident was placed on 2025-08-24 at about 09:25. The online submission was made by Senthil Prakash (9000000067). Nandha Karuppasamy (mobile 9000000113) was named as a possible person of interest. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100024. A further person, Arun Babu, a driver, using the number 9000000379, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, morning, mobile number, screenshot, suspect, main street, associate
